questions.question: In a company, there are only two types of employees: workers and officers. The average monthly salary of an officer is ₹78,000 more than the combined average monthly salary of an employee, while the combined average monthly salary of an employee is ₹42,000 more than the average monthly salary of a worker. What percentage of all the employees are officers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average monthly salary of an officer = Rs 78,0
00 more than the combined average monthly salary of an employee.

Combined average monthly salary of an employee = Rs 42,000 more than the average monthly salary of a worker

**Calculation:**

Let the average monthly salary of workers be x

According to the question,

Average monthly salary of an employee = 42000 + x

Average monthly salary of an officer = 78000 + (42000 + x) = 120000 + x

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1f6dfb6c02aeb9328797e082945399165907832dad694fdf92f0b8482a3139a.png] 

So,

Officers : Workers = 21 : 39

Percentage of all the employees who are officers = (21)/(21+39) × 100 = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

questions.question: In a company, there are only two types of employees, workers, and officers. 35% of the employees are officers and the average monthly salary of an officer is ₹39,000 more than the combined average monthly salary of all employees. What is the difference between the average monthly salaries of an officer and a worker?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Officers : Workers = 35% : 65% = 7 : 13.

Deviation of Officer's salary from the combined average = +₹39,000.

Applying the net deviation rule: Sum of deviations = 0.

7 × (+39,000) + 13 × (Worker's deviation) = 0.

Worker's deviation = −(7 × 39,000) ÷ 13 = −₹21,000.

Total difference = Officer's surplus + Worker's deficit = 39,000 + 21,000 = ₹60,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of Officers = 35%

Percentage of Workers = 100% − 35% = 65%

AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − AvgTₒₜₐₗ = ₹39,000

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average: n₁(A₁ − Aₐvg) = n₂(Aₐvg − A₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b23348bb97cdfe1aec5cfe9df57aa3fcdf32bd14c9c4f6d7e68f19b91bb7b8ac.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of Officers (nO) to Workers (nW) = 35 : 65 = 7 : 13

⇒ Let AvgTₒₜₐₗ be A, then AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ = A + 39,000

⇒ Let AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ be AW

⇒ 7 × (AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − A) = 13 × (A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ)

⇒ 7 × (39,000) = 13 × (A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ)

⇒ A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ = (7 × 39,000) ÷ 13

⇒ A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ = 7 × 3,000 = 21,000

⇒ Difference = AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ

⇒ Difference = (AvgOffᵢ꜀ₑᵣ − A) + (A − AvgWₒᵣₖₑᵣ)

⇒ Difference = 39,000 + 21,000 = 60,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹60,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule for Averages

The ratio of the quantities of two groups is the inverse ratio of the differences of their individual averages from the combined average: n₁/n₂ = (A₂ − Aₐvg) / (Aₐvg − A₁).

Net Deviation Method

In any distribution, the sum of the products of the frequency and the deviation of each value from the mean is always zero: ∑ fᵢ(xᵢ − x̄) = 0.

Weighted Average Formula

The combined average of two groups is given by Aₐvg = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) / (n₁ + n₂), where n represents the number of items and A represents the average.

questions.question: There are three numbers. If the average of any two of them is added to the third number, the sums obtained are 177, 163 and 138. What is the average of the largest and the smallest of the given numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be a, b and c.

According to the question,

(a + b)/2 + c = 177 or a + b + 2c = 354 ….(1)

(b + c)/2 + a = 163 or 2a + b + c = 326 ….(2)

(c + a)/2 + b = 138 or a + 2b + c = 276 ….(3)

On solving the three equations,

c = 115, b = 37, a = 87

Required average = (115 + 37)/2 = 76.

questions.question: The numbers 24, 45, a, 35, 59, 83, 46, b, 29, 74 are serially numbered as they appear in the sequence. When each number is added to its serial number, then the average of the new numbers formed is 55. The average of the missing numbers (a and b) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The given numbers are 24, 45, a, 35, 59, 83, 46, b, 29, 74

Average of 10 numbers when each number is added to its serial number = 55

**Formula:**

Average = Sum of all observations/total number of all observations

**Calculation:**

New numbers are when each number is added to its serial number

(24 + 1), (45 + 2), (a + 3), (35 + 4), (59 + 5), (83 + 6), (46 + 7), (b + 8), (29 + 9), (74 + 10)

According to the question

(24 + 1) + (45 + 2) + (a + 3) + (35 + 4) + (59 + 5) + (83 + 6) + (46 + 7) + (b + 8) + (29 + 9) + (74 + 10) = 55 × 10

⇒ 450 + a + b = 550

⇒ a + b = 550 - 450

⇒ a + b = 100

∴ Average of a and b = 100/2 = 50

questions.question: The average height of a certain number of students in a group is 155.6 cm. If 12 students having an average height of 150.5 cm join the group and 7 students having an average height of 159 cm leave the group, the average height of the students in the group will decrease by 34 mm. What is the number of students, initially, in the group?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average height of a certain number of students in a group is 155.6 cm.

12 students having an average height of 150.5 cm join the group

7 students having an average height of 159 cm leave the group

The average height of the students in the group will decrease by 34 mm i.e. 3.4 cm

Concept used:

Let xn be the observations and wn be the weights of the observations; the formula of the weighted average is given below.

W = (w1x1+ w2x2 + w3x3+ ... + wnxn) ÷ (w1 + w2 + w3 + .... + wn)

Calculation:

Let the intial number of students be P.

So, total height of P students = (P × 155.6) cm

Now, total height increased by = (12 × 150.5) = 1806 cm

Then, total height decreased by = (7 × 159) = 1113 cm

Now, the total change in height = (1806 - 1113) = 693 cm

The final number of stundets = (P + 12 - 7) = (P + 5)

According to the question,

155.6 × P + 693 = (155.6 - 3.4) × (P + 5)

⇒ P = 20

**∴ The number of students initially in the group was 20.**

questions.question: The average weight of some persons in a group is 72 kg. When 5 persons with average weight 66.6 kg join and 13 persons with average weight 75 kg leave the group, the average weight of the persons in the group decreases by 1.65 kg. How many persons were there in the group initially?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of some persons = 72 kg 

Average weight of 5 persons = 66.6 kg 

Average weight of 13 persons = 75 kg 

**Formula used:**

Average Weight = Total weight/No of persons 

⇒ Total weight = Average weight × No of persons

questions.question: The average weight of some students in a group is 58 kg. If 8 students of average weight 54 kg leave the group, and 3 students weighing 53.6 kg, 54 kg and 57.4 kg join the group, then the average weight of the remaining students in the group will increase by 575 g. The number of students, initially, in the group is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of some students = 58 kg

Weight of 8 students who leave the group = 54 kg

Number of three students who joined the group = 53.6, 54 and 57.4 kg

Average weight of the remaining students increase = 575 g

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students be x

According to the question

⇒ [(58 × x) – (8 × 54) + (53.6 + 54 + 57.4)] = (x – 8 + 3) (58 + 0.575)

⇒ 58x – 432 + 165 = (x – 5) (58.575)

⇒ 58x – 267 = (58.575x – 292.875)

⇒ (58.575x – 58x) = (292.875 – 267)

⇒ 0.575x = 25.875

⇒ x = (25.875/0.575)

⇒ x = 45

**∴ The number of the students in the group is 45**
